recommendations.statement: Don't do imaging for low back pain within the first six weeks unless red flags are present.
recommendations.precondition: acute low back pain of less than 6 weeks with no red flags (major trauma, neurological deficit, history of cancer, unexplained weight loss, fever/infection, IV drug use)
recommendations.consider_instead: conservative management with reassessment; image only if red flags emerge or symptoms persist beyond 6 weeks
recommendations.rationale: Imaging of the low back before six weeks does not improve outcomes but exposes patients to unnecessary cost, radiation, and incidental findings that prompt further low-value testing.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't routinely prescribe antibiotics for uncomplicated upper respiratory infections or mild acute rhinosinusitis.
recommendations.precondition: uncomplicated viral upper respiratory infection, or acute rhinosinusitis with mild-to-moderate symptoms of less than 7 days
recommendations.consider_instead: symptomatic treatment; reserve antibiotics for persistent (>10 days), severe, or worsening ('double-sickening') presentations
recommendations.rationale: Most acute URIs and sinusitis are viral and self-limited; antibiotics do not speed recovery and drive resistance and adverse effects.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't obtain routine preoperative chest radiographs, ECGs, or laboratory tests in asymptomatic patients undergoing low-risk surgery.
recommendations.precondition: asymptomatic patient with no active cardiopulmonary disease undergoing low-risk / minor surgery
recommendations.consider_instead: test selectively based on history, examination, and the specific procedure
recommendations.rationale: Routine preoperative testing in asymptomatic patients for low-risk surgery rarely changes management and generates false positives and downstream testing.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't screen for prostate cancer using a PSA test without a discussion of the risks and benefits.
recommendations.precondition: asymptomatic average-risk man, particularly under 55 or over 69 years, without shared decision-making
recommendations.consider_instead: shared decision-making before any PSA testing
recommendations.rationale: PSA screening without informed discussion leads to over-diagnosis and over-treatment of indolent disease with significant harms.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't perform neuroimaging (CT or MRI) for patients with stable headaches that meet criteria for migraine.
recommendations.precondition: recurrent headaches meeting migraine criteria, stable pattern, normal neurological examination, no red flags
recommendations.consider_instead: clinical diagnosis; image only for red flags (thunderclap onset, new/progressive deficit, immunosuppression, age >50 new headache)
recommendations.rationale: Neuroimaging in stable migraine without red flags almost never reveals significant pathology and drives incidentalomas and cost.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't use benzodiazepines or other sedative-hypnotics in older adults as the first choice for insomnia, agitation, or delirium.
recommendations.precondition: older adult (typically 65+) with insomnia, agitation, or delirium
recommendations.consider_instead: non-pharmacological measures first; treat underlying causes
recommendations.rationale: Older adults are more sensitive to benzodiazepines, with markedly increased risk of cognitive impairment, falls, fractures, and motor-vehicle crashes.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't transfuse red blood cells for arbitrary hemoglobin or hematocrit thresholds in the absence of symptoms, active bleeding, or hemodynamic instability.
recommendations.precondition: hemodynamically stable, non-bleeding hospitalized patient with hemoglobin at or above the restrictive threshold (7-8 g/dL)
recommendations.consider_instead: restrictive transfusion strategy; transfuse for symptoms rather than a number
recommendations.rationale: A restrictive transfusion threshold is as safe as or safer than liberal transfusion and avoids the costs and risks of unnecessary blood products.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't repeat colorectal cancer screening by colonoscopy for 10 years after a high-quality normal colonoscopy in average-risk individuals.
recommendations.precondition: average-risk individual with a prior high-quality colonoscopy that was normal, within the last 10 years
recommendations.consider_instead: resume screening at the guideline-recommended 10-year interval
recommendations.rationale: Repeating colonoscopy sooner than 10 years after a normal high-quality examination in average-risk patients adds risk and cost without benefit.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't perform stress cardiac imaging or coronary angiography in patients without cardiac symptoms unless high-risk markers are present.
recommendations.precondition: asymptomatic patient at low risk for coronary artery disease, without high-risk markers, being considered for screening cardiac imaging
recommendations.consider_instead: risk-factor assessment and modification; test only symptomatic or high-risk patients
recommendations.rationale: Screening stress imaging in asymptomatic low-risk patients rarely changes management and leads to false positives, radiation, and invasive follow-up.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't use advanced imaging (PET, CT, or radionuclide bone scans) to stage early breast or prostate cancer at low risk for metastasis.
recommendations.precondition: newly diagnosed early-stage, low-risk breast or prostate cancer without signs or symptoms of metastasis
recommendations.consider_instead: reserve advanced staging imaging for higher-stage or symptomatic disease
recommendations.rationale: Advanced imaging to stage low-risk early cancers has a very low yield of true metastases and generates false positives, cost, and radiation.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't use antimicrobials to treat asymptomatic bacteriuria.
recommendations.precondition: positive urine culture in a patient with no urinary symptoms (excluding pregnancy and pre-urologic-procedure settings)
recommendations.consider_instead: no treatment; treat only symptomatic urinary tract infection
recommendations.rationale: Treating asymptomatic bacteriuria does not improve outcomes and promotes resistance, C. difficile, and drug adverse effects.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't prescribe stress ulcer prophylaxis to medical inpatients unless they are at high risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
recommendations.precondition: medical inpatient outside the ICU without high-risk features for GI bleeding (mechanical ventilation, coagulopathy, GI bleed history)
recommendations.consider_instead: reserve acid suppression for patients meeting high-risk criteria
recommendations.rationale: Routine stress ulcer prophylaxis in low-risk inpatients does not prevent clinically important bleeding and increases pneumonia and C. difficile risk.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't obtain CT scans in children with minor head injuries who are low-risk by validated clinical criteria.
recommendations.precondition: child with minor head injury classified as low-risk by a validated decision rule (e.g. PECARN)
recommendations.consider_instead: observation and validated decision rules rather than routine CT
recommendations.rationale: CT in low-risk minor pediatric head injury rarely finds significant injury and exposes children to ionizing radiation and future cancer risk.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Avoid CT of the head in adults with minor head injury who are at low risk based on validated decision rules.
recommendations.precondition: adult with minor head injury who is low-risk by a validated decision rule (e.g. Canadian CT Head Rule)
recommendations.consider_instead: apply validated decision rules; observe rather than scan low-risk patients
recommendations.rationale: Validated decision rules safely identify adults with minor head injury who do not need CT, reducing radiation and cost.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't routinely order a thyroid ultrasound in patients with abnormal thyroid function tests if there is no palpable abnormality of the thyroid gland.
recommendations.precondition: abnormal TSH or thyroid function tests without a palpable thyroid nodule or goiter
recommendations.consider_instead: ultrasound only when a nodule is palpable or incidentally found
recommendations.rationale: Thyroid ultrasound for abnormal function tests without a palpable nodule detects clinically insignificant nodules and drives unnecessary biopsies.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't obtain screening resting or exercise electrocardiograms in asymptomatic adults at low risk for coronary heart disease.
recommendations.precondition: asymptomatic adult at low risk for coronary heart disease undergoing routine health assessment
recommendations.consider_instead: cardiovascular risk-factor assessment instead of screening ECG
recommendations.rationale: Screening ECGs in low-risk asymptomatic adults rarely change management and lead to false positives and a cascade of further testing.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't perform DEXA (bone density) screening for osteoporosis in women younger than 65 or men younger than 70 with no risk factors.
recommendations.precondition: woman under 65 or man under 70 with no osteoporosis risk factors
recommendations.consider_instead: screen at the guideline age, or earlier only if risk factors are present
recommendations.rationale: Bone-density screening in younger low-risk adults has low yield and can lead to unnecessary treatment.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Don't perform repetitive daily laboratory testing (such as CBC and chemistry panels) in the face of clinical and laboratory stability.
recommendations.precondition: clinically stable hospitalized patient with stable laboratory values
recommendations.consider_instead: order labs to answer a specific clinical question rather than by daily routine
recommendations.rationale: Repetitive daily labs in stable inpatients contribute to iatrogenic anemia, false positives, patient discomfort, and cost without changing management.
recommendations.notes: AI-transcribed from the well-established ABIM Choosing Wisely clinician lists; substance is stable/canonical. Spot-check advised.

recommendations.statement: Do not use PET-CT routinely to monitor response in patients receiving palliative chemotherapy.
recommendations.precondition: patient on palliative-intent chemotherapy for advanced cancer, being monitored for response
recommendations.consider_instead: clinical assessment and conventional imaging as indicated
recommendations.rationale: Routine PET-CT to monitor palliative chemotherapy adds substantial cost without improving outcomes or altering the palliative treatment plan.
